sentences.text: Sheet 06.04.2026 Heard Shri D.K. Gwalre, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the present transfer petition has been filed under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 seeking transfer of Case No. HMA/1120/2025, a petition filed under Section 13(1)(ia) and 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, pending before the Court of First Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Raipur (C.G.) to the Family Court at Ambikapur (C.G.).

entities.text: Court of First Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Raipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that the applicant is the legally wedded wife of the non-applicant and is presently residing at Ambikapur along with her minor school- going son aged about 7 years, and is entirely dependent upon her aged parents for her livelihood.

It is further submitted that due to her responsibility of taking care of her young child, it is extremely difficult for her to leave him and travel long distances to attend the court proceedings at Raipur.
Learned counsel further submits that the applicant has undergone a major surgery and is not in a physical condition to undertake frequent travel, as it causes her severe pain and hardship.
It is also submitted that the distance between Ambikapur and Raipur is more than 350 kilometers, making it highly inconvenient for the applicant to attend each and every hearing.

Digitally signed by It is further contended that the non-applicant is SHOAIB SHOAIB ANWAR ANWAR Date:
2026.04.06 already facing criminal prosecution in connection 18:10:54 +0530 with offences under Section 498A of the IPC and Section 3 of the Dowry Prohibition Act at Ambikapur, wherein he has already appeared before the competent court.

Therefore,
it would be convenient for both parties if the present matrimonial case is also transferred to Ambikapur to avoid multiplicity of proceedings.
Issue notice to the non-applicant on payment of process fee within ten days.

Considering the submissions made and the facts and circumstances of the case,
particularly the medical condition of the applicant, her responsibility towards her minor school-going child aged about 7 years, the distance involved, and the pendency of connected proceedings at Ambikapur
, this Court finds it appropriate to grant interim protection.

Accordingly, it is directed that further proceedings of Case No. HMA/1120/2025 (petition under Section 13(1)(ia) & 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955)
pending before the Court of First Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Raipur Radhika Gupta @ Renu Mittal vs Rahul Gupta on 6 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62728748/
1 (C.G.) shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
List the case after service of notice.
